# R5.24 — Repair R0 lifecycle and prove clean-recipient verifyfixed

## Summary

Repairs the R0 lifecycle defect A3 documented as F6
(`docs/research/03_newcomer-journey.md:186–196`) and proves the
clean-recipient verifyfixed path. `kernel.reproduce`'s R0 fold read
the terminal `lifecycle.run.*` row's `payload.status` — the
task-outcome plane (`succeeded`/`failed_honest`/…) — and compared it
against the manifest's `subject.status`, which the producer folds
from `lifecycle.run.finished` *presence* (`open`/`finished`). Every
completed run reported `lifecycle_status` drift on byte-perfect
bundles. The fold now uses the producer's own presence rule — the
§9.3 admitted existing-contract fix "R0 open/finished mapping
(R-2.9.3)", not an amendment. `decode_dir` additionally gains the
§6.3 recipient bounds: path/link escape (`MemberEscape`) and
resource expansion beyond the declared index size
(`MemberExpansion`) refuse *before* bytes materialize.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-embed/src/bundle_ops.rs` — R0 fold derives
  `open`/`finished` from `lifecycle.run.finished` presence only;
  `payload.status`/`stop_reason`/`outcome_class` never read.
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/codec.rs` — `decode_dir` refuses
  non-regular member entries and `bundle.json` links
  (`MemberEscape`), and member files larger than declared `size`
  (`MemberExpansion`; undeclared binds at the native blob bound).
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/error.rs` — the two typed variants riding
  `bundle_err → Refused{reason}`.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_24.rs` — 9-case battery (see AC table).
- ADR-0402 (landing record), coverage dated note, run ledger.
